purpose: Teach: インストラクター/障壁/離職/測量/バリアフリー/粉飾/生計/ステータス

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、自らインストラクターを務められた
lines.en: Your father — he trained people as an instructor himself.
lines.style: Gentle, respectful tone. Slow, deliberate pacing that honors the memory. Warm distance in the voice, like looking back at something precious and distant.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは業界の障壁を打ち破られた
lines.en: Yes. He broke through the barriers in our industry.
lines.style: Steady, measured affirmation. Light emphasis on the accomplishment without pride. Eye-contact held. A son speaking his father's legacy plainly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の離職を一番嫌った
lines.en: Your father — he hated staff turnover more than anything.
lines.style: Soft, almost mourning quality. Slight catch on the emphasis of "hated." Looking inward, remembering a conviction. Trailing fade.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、現場の測量は社長自ら行うのが伝統
lines.en: Yes. From his time onward, it became tradition — the president does the site surveys himself.
lines.style: Warm respect woven through. Not reciting, but carrying forward. The words land lightly but firmly, like a hand placed on the next generation's shoulder.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社屋のバリアフリー化を早期に決断された
lines.en: Your father — he made the early decision to make the building fully accessible.
lines.style: Gentle reverence. Slight wonder at the foresight. Each word deliberate. Trailing softly, like recognizing something ahead of its time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは粉飾を絶対許さなかった
lines.en: Yes. He would not tolerate dishonesty under any circumstances.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. A quiet line drawn. Measured breath. The kind of quiet that shows resolve, not anger. Grounded certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員の生計を守るのが使命だとおっしゃった
lines.en: Your father — he said protecting his employees' livelihoods was his mission.
lines.style: Deep conviction underneath. Slow, weighted delivery. The voice carries something almost sacred. Slight breath before "mission" — the weight of the word.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはブランドのステータス向上に尽力された
lines.en: Yes. He devoted himself to lifting the reputation of the company itself.
lines.style: Thoughtful closure. Measured, reflective. The final piece settling into place. Warm finality without abruptness. A gentle close that honors what has been said.
